entities.summary: Farid Nada al-Madhhan is a former Syrian officer with the rank of First Assistant. He held the position of Head of the Judicial Evidence Office in the Military Police in Damascus, and was the officer who leaked photos of victims in the Syrian regime's detention centers during Bashar al-Assad's rule amid the Syrian revolution, under the alias Caesar.
